Build the independence report for the contributing lenses (Stage-0 SS10)

Source: R/independence.R
independence_report.Rd

One row per contributing opinion lens, carrying its two-level key, maturity tier, and a corroboration discount. The discount reflects: koine-first maturity (SS11), within-family kernel redundancy, and membership of a collapse grouping. This feeds the downstream fourth-vs-three grading.

Usage

independence_report(fb_fits)

Arguments

fb_fits

A list of contributed koine_fb_fit objects.

Value

A data frame with columns lens_id, family, kernel, maturity_tier, discount, and collapsed_witness.

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(y = rnorm(40), x = rnorm(40))
pass <- koine_pass(y ~ x, d, gaussian())
fit <- fit_dram(pass, n_iter = 600L, n_burn = 300L, n_chains = 2L)
independence_report(list(fit))
#>   lens_id      family kernel               maturity_tier discount
#> 1    dram random_walk   dram koine-implemented-validated      0.5
#>   collapsed_witness
#> 1              <NA>
# }
